{% translate "Security Rules" %}

{% url 'doc' 'monitoring_rules/securityscripts' as sec_scripts %} {% blocktranslate trimmed %} Security rules monitor various events on the monitored computers. The type of events that are monitored by a security rule are determined by the Security Script used for that security rule. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} The security script is executed to collect possible events every time a monitored computer checks in with the admin portal. As the computers check in every 5 minutes, it can thus take up to 5 minutes from the time when an event occurred until the event is reported on the admin portal and an email-notification is sent. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "A computer can only check in and report events if it is turned on and has an internet connection." %}

{% translate "Creating or editing security rules" %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} The overview "Monitoring Rules" shows all the defined security rules and offline rules that are monitored. You can edit an existing security rule by selecting it in the list. You can define a new security rule by clicking on "Add new security rule" above the list. The interface for both operations has the same form. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% translate "A security rule has the following parameters" %}:

  • {% translate "Name (mandatory): the name of the particular security rule." %}
  • {% translate "Security Script (mandatory): The Security Script is executed every time the computer checks in with the admin portal." %}
  • {% translate "Severity level (mandatory): Choose between Critical, High and Normal." %}
  • {% translate "Description (optional): A descriptive text that is included in the sent email warnings." %}
  • {% blocktranslate trimmed %} Monitored groups (optional): The groups define which computers the security rule applies to. If no groups are specified, the security rule will apply to all computers on the site. {% endblocktranslate %}
  • {% blocktranslate trimmed %} Recipient(s) of email warning (optional): The users that should receive an email about any events related to the security rule. Note that if a monitored PC belongs to one or more groups with supervisors, those supervisors will receive any email warnings related to that PC instead of the recipients set here. {% endblocktranslate %}

{% blocktranslate trimmed %} Any changes made to a security rule will not take effect until you have clicked on "Save changes" at the bottom of the screen. Similarly, you must click on "Save changes" to finish creating a new security rule once you have filled out the mandatory parameters. You can verify that the security rule has been created by checking if it appears in the list of monitored rules. {% endblocktranslate %}
